# nanoflags_sdk_keys (Data Source)

Lists SDK key **metadata** (name, kind, prefix, usage). The Management API never returns key material, and SDK keys are created and revoked in the dashboard, so there is no SDK key resource. Admin role, scope `keys:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nanoflags_sdk_keys" "production" {
  project     = "web"
  environment = "production"
}

output "production_key_prefixes" {
  value = [for k in data.nanoflags_sdk_keys.production.keys : "${k.name} (${k.kind}): ${k.prefix}…"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project key or id.

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Environment key or id. Omitted: every environment.
- `include_revoked` (Boolean) Include revoked keys. Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `environment` (String) Environment key.
- `id` (String) Key id.
- `kind` (String) `client`, `server`, `ci` or `admin`.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last use.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `prefix` (String) First characters of the key, safe to display.
- `revoked_at` (String) Revocation time.
